item.title: Fly-tipping and unsecured entrance next to empty property – 29/30 Orlop Street, 30th October
item.description:
The entrance to 29/30 Orlop Street SE10 9AB has no door, and people regularly dump rubbish there. On Friday 30 October a 50-litre bag of empty glass bottles and a broken drawer were left at the entrance, blocking the path to residents' homes. Broken glass in the dark is a safety hazard. The entrance is also very dark at night, and a few weeks ago a woman was hiding there, which frightened a resident. It is next to an empty house that is full of debris and uncollected items, which looks neglected and could attract trespassers. Please can you remove the rubbish, check the empty house, and contact the landowner about securing the entrance. I have also written to the letting agency asking for a door to be fitted.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Orlop Street, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
